import unittest

from solution import downgrade_rows, upgrade_rows


class RowMigrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_upgrade_adds_deterministic_ids_in_order(self):
        rows = [{"name": "alpha"}, {"name": "beta"}, {}]
        result = upgrade_rows(rows)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"name": "alpha", "unique_id": "I" + "0" * 31},
            {"name": "beta", "unique_id": "I" + "0" * 30 + "1"},
            {"unique_id": "I" + "0" * 30 + "2"},
        ])
        ids = [row["unique_id"] for row in result]
        self.assertEqual(len(set(ids)), 3)
        for value in ids:
            self.assertEqual(len(value), 32)
            self.assertEqual(value[0], "I")
            self.assertEqual(value[1:], value[1:].lower())
            int(value[1:], 16)

    def test_hexadecimal_index_encoding(self):
        result = upgrade_rows([{} for _ in range(17)])
        self.assertEqual(result[15]["unique_id"], "I" + "0" * 30 + "f")
        self.assertEqual(result[16]["unique_id"], "I" + "0" * 29 + "10")

    def test_downgrade_removes_ids_when_present(self):
        rows = [
            {"unique_id": "anything", "name": "a"},
            {"name": "b"},
            {"unique_id": None},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(downgrade_rows(rows), [{"name": "a"}, {"name": "b"}, {}])

    def test_empty_lists(self):
        self.assertEqual(upgrade_rows([]), [])
        self.assertEqual(downgrade_rows([]), [])

    def test_upgrade_rejects_existing_key_without_mutation(self):
        rows = [{"name": "ok"}, {"unique_id": "existing", "nested": [1]}]
        snapshot = [{"name": "ok"}, {"unique_id": "existing", "nested": [1]}]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            upgrade_rows(rows)
        self.assertEqual(rows, snapshot)

    def test_container_validation(self):
        for function in (upgrade_rows, downgrade_rows):
            for bad in (None, (), {}, "rows"):
                with self.subTest(function=function.__name__, bad=bad):
                    with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                        function(bad)
            for bad_row in (None, [], "row", 1):
                with self.subTest(function=function.__name__, bad_row=bad_row):
                    with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                        function([{}, bad_row])

    def test_upgrade_deep_copies_without_aliasing_input(self):
        nested = {"items": [[1, 2], {"key": [3]}]}
        rows = [{"nested": nested}]
        result = upgrade_rows(rows)
        self.assertIsNot(result, rows)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], rows[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["nested"], nested)
        result[0]["nested"]["items"][0].append(99)
        result[0]["nested"]["items"][1]["key"].append(88)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [{"nested": {"items": [[1, 2], {"key": [3]}]}}])
        rows[0]["nested"]["items"][0].append(77)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["nested"]["items"][0], [1, 2, 99])

    def test_downgrade_deep_copies_without_aliasing_input(self):
        rows = [{"unique_id": "id", "nested": {"values": [1, 2]}}]
        result = downgrade_rows(rows)
        result[0]["nested"]["values"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [{"unique_id": "id", "nested": {"values": [1, 2]}}])
        rows[0]["nested"]["values"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(result, [{"nested": {"values": [1, 2, 3]}}])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
